title: Three-bit parity interpolation over the binary field
statement:
For $x_1,x_2,x_3\in\mathbb F_2$, the sum of the four products that indicate the odd-parity inputs equals $x_1+x_2+x_3$ in $\mathbb F_2$:
\[(1-x_1)(1-x_2)x_3+(1-x_1)x_2(1-x_3)+x_1(1-x_2)(1-x_3)+x_1x_2x_3=x_1+x_2+x_3.\]
hypotheses_covered: $x_1,x_2,x_3$ belong to the field with two elements
